text:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: inference.http.5xx_rate spike for service=inference-gateway-us-west1 (threshold 3% -> 12%)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345 - triggered by prometheus
maya: omg saw this on dashboards, thanks for the page. I'm on it.
samir: i'll grab logs and check upstreams. @maya do you want me to start scaling pools?
maya: yes please. try scaling the edge-gateway deployment first, there's a known kv-cache GC bug we've seen once.
leo: tagging in ops-rotation for capacity ops if we need node restarts.
ops-rotation: acknowledged. standing by for runbook ops.
eli: FYI customer impact: initial signal shows ~4% of requests returning 5xx, ramping to 11% over 3m. Top path /v1/generate, most failures are 502/504.
maya: copying important logs below to look for KV cache errors:
```
2026-03-14T03:45:11Z gateway[pid=1123] WARN kv_cache: eviction loop stalled for 24s
2026-03-14T03:45:12Z proxy ERROR upstream request failed: read timeout
2026-03-14T03:45:15Z model-proxy INFO serve: dropped connection during tail generation
```
samir: grep across logs shows same GC stall marker on 3 hosts (edge-1, edge-3, edge-7).
leo: i'm going to bump replica count and trigger a rolling restart on the edge-gateway pool.
maya: do a controlled increase + routing weight shift to fallback region (us-east) while we stabilize. use routing service to move 30% traffic off us-west1.
samir: running commands:
```
kubectl scale deploy/edge-gateway -n prod --replicas=12
kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-gateway -n prod --selector=zone=us-west1
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/shifts -d '{"from":"us-west1","to":"us-east1","pct":30}'
```
ops-rotation: starting rolling restart on nodes edge-1/3/7 now. will serially drain and reboot. ETA ~8m.
product-support: alert from enterprise-customer acme-corp about latency spikes; can we confirm if they're affected?
eli: acme-corp has 2.3% of failing requests in the window, not a major percentage but they reported front-end errors. I'll send a note to their CSM after we have mitigation.
maya: observing drop in 5xx rate from 11% -> 6% since routing shift and restarts. good sign. keep monitoring.
samir: i see repeated kv_cache WARNs; temporary mitigation: disable prefix caching for long tails to avoid pressure. patching config:
```
service.gateway.cache.prefix: false
```
leo: patch applied on canary, promoting to 50% of us-west1 traffic.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident PD12345 acknowledged by maya (oncall-sre).
pagerduty-bot: Escalation to primary SRE rotation suppressed (ack received)
maya: metrics look stable at 3.1% now. rolling restart finished on all affected nodes.
ops-rotation: one node had kubelet OOM during restart, recovered after systemd restart; no data loss.
eli: customer impact summary so far: ~7 minutes of elevated 5xx, peak error rate ~12%, approx 1.8% of total platform requests affected in window, top customers: acme-corp, beta-analytics. No data exposure.
product-support: i'll draft a short incident note for acme-corp and hold until we confirm RCA.
samir: digging into root cause — initial hypothesis: KV cache eviction loop blocked under high tail-latency workloads combined with a change in model-proxy keepalive behavior at 03:40 UTC. I'll correlate deploy history.
maya: can someone check deploys around 03:38-03:41?
leo: checking deploy logs: no model-proxy deploys at that minute. there was a config push to gateway routing rules at 03:36 that adjusted keepalive timeout from 2s -> 5s (PR #4127).
samir: that config change plus heavier request tails likely extended connections and triggered eviction stall. filing RCA ticket INF-2026-87.
maya: ok next steps: 1) keep prefix caching disabled until patch, 2) revert the keepalive increase in canary, 3) follow-up postmortem with timeline and mitigation. assign owners: samir for RCA, leo for infra fix, maya for customer comms.
incident-bot: Status changed to "mitigated" by maya. closing PagerDuty incident PD12345 will auto-resolve in 5m if no new alerts. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team. handoff to day-oncall in 30m for post-incident monitoring.
ops-rotation: handoff noted, will continue 1hr watch.
product-support: sending preliminary note to acme-corp now: "We observed transient 5xx errors affecting a subset of requests between 03:40–03:47 UTC; mitigation applied and service restored. Your CSM will follow up."
eli: logging RCA ticket and attach logs + timeline. will update incident thread when available.
samir: leaving a quick mitigation snippet for runbook:
```
if 5xx_rate > 5% and kv_cache WARNs:
  - shift routing 30% -> fallback region
  - scale edge-gateway replicas + serial restart
  - disable prefix cache
  - roll back recent keepalive config change
```
maya: nice. closing thread for now, will reopen if PD re-triggers. :pray:
